menus.openChooser.description: Right-click menu of the toolbar icon (only when the icon sends in one click): opens the window for choosing a device. “Tabsend” is the product name. Keep it short; menu items are clipped.

menus.addDevice.description: Right-click menu entry on a page, link or tab when no other device is paired yet: opens the setup page. Starts with the product name “Tabsend”. Keep it short; menu items are clipped.

menus.sendTabTo.description: Right-click menu entry on a page or tab when exactly one other device is paired. {device} is that device's name. Keep it short; menu items are clipped.

menus.sendLinkTo.description: Right-click menu entry on a link when exactly one other device is paired. {device} is that device's name. Keep it short; menu items are clipped.

menus.sendTabToParent.description: Right-click menu entry on a page or tab that opens a list of devices to choose from (two or more paired). The device names appear in the list below it, so there is no device name in this text.

menus.sendLinkToParent.description: Right-click menu entry on a link that opens a list of devices to choose from (two or more paired). The device names appear in the list below it, so there is no device name in this text.
